# arXiv HTML fixtures

Real `https://arxiv.org/html/<id>` pages downloaded during Phase 0 and saved unchanged, without cleanup, for rule, placeholder, and rendering tests.
Copyright belongs to the paper authors; these files are used only as test data. Initial download date: 2026-09-03.

Download and statistics scripts: `scripts/phase0/fetch-candidates.sh` queries the API by category and date and downloads pages; `scripts/phase0/candidate-stats.sh` counts features.
Every fixture was generated by `LaTeXML oxide (version 0.7.6)`, including the 2023 papers; see `docs/RESEARCH.md` §1.

Counting conventions: `math` counts `<math`; `eqn` counts `ltx_equation`; `listing` counts `ltx_listingline`; `algo` counts `ltx_float_algorithm|ltx_algorithm`; `td` counts `ltx_td`; `note` counts `ltx_note_content`; `thm` counts `ltx_theorem`; `svg` counts `<svg`. These coarse grep counts serve fixture selection only; see `docs/RESEARCH.md` §2 for the precise audit.

## synthetic-structures.html (synthetic, not a real paper)

LaTeXML / ar5iv stylesheets contain 145 classes absent from the 30 downloaded papers, including book, CV, index, and epigraph templates; see RESEARCH.md §2.12.
This file follows LaTeXML output conventions to include each text-bearing structure: part/chapter/section headings, epigraphs, block quotations, description lists, marginal notes,
index entries, CV items, subfigure captions, verbatim blocks, algorithm boxes, and conversion errors. It guards against missed translations in previously unseen structures.
When adding structures, update RESEARCH.md §2.12 as well.
